project_type: Next.js 16.3.6 App Router with TypeScript, Prisma ORM 6.4.1, PostgreSQL multi-tenant SaaS platform
test_framework: No test framework installed yet - will need to verify manually with build and runtime checks
test_command: npm run lint (for syntax checks only - no unit tests exist)
verification_instructions: After each feature: (1) Run 'npm run build' to verify TypeScript compilation, (2) Run 'npx prisma validate' after schema changes, (3) Run 'npx prisma migrate dev' for new migrations, (4) Start dev server with 'npm run dev' and test affected endpoints with curl/Postman
snapshot_or_generated_files: prisma/migrations/* are generated by Prisma and should be committed. No other generated files are checked in.
environment_constraints: Next.js 16 uses Turbopack by default with different behavior than webpack. JWT_SECRET must be set or server will not start after fixes. Database must be running for Prisma operations. Payment gateway webhooks cannot be fully tested locally without ngrok/webhook forwarding.
contribution_requirements: From AGENTS.md: Next.js 16 has breaking changes from training data - read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ for current APIs. All features must maintain multi-tenant isolation. Environment variables in .env.example must be documented.
key_patterns: All API routes use verifyToken(token) for authentication and filter by session.tenantId for tenant isolation. Error handling uses try-catch with console.error and NextResponse.json. Prisma queries use findFirst with tenantId filter. [id] routes check 'findFirst({ where: { id, tenantId } })' before operations. No raw SQL queries exist (good - no SQL injection risk).
directory_structure: src/app/api/* contains all API routes (20+ routes including [id] dynamic routes). src/lib/* contains shared utilities (auth, prisma, payment-gateways, subscriptions, tenant). prisma/ contains schema and migrations. All [id] routes follow pattern: GET by id, PUT updates, DELETE removes - all with tenantId checks.
